description: This is a test source file for the HealthStore component in the OpenClaw project. It contains unit tests verifying behavior when a linked channel probe fails, ensuring the health store state transitions to degraded properly.

classes.name: HealthStoreStateTests
classes.description: A test suite for HealthStore state behaviors related to health snapshots and probe failures.

methods.name: `linked channel probe failure degrades state`
methods.description: A unit test method that verifies when a linked channel's probe fails, the HealthStore state transitions to degraded and appropriate messages are produced.
